This causes non-coalesced L1TEX loads, confirmed by 20.5-cycle average L1TEX stalls (39.2% of all stall cycles) and 10% excessive sectors. The current XBLOCK=128/YBLOCK=8 tile shape does not align threads with the contiguous memory dimension. Adding @triton.autotune explores tile shapes where YBLOCK is larger (covering more of the contiguous channel dimension y0) and XBLOCK is smaller, which can dramatically improve coalescing on the input load and reduce L2 pressure.
